mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate compresses risk-free rates in equity valuation models, increasing present values of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% or Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST decline AND RSAFS decline) fails to produce negative returns in >60% of instances or Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), a federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25pp over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL > 240.0 AND FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp) fails to produce negative returns in >60% of instances or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates reduced manufacturing activity that lowers corporate earnings growth expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 5-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 1200.0 thousand units signals residential construction contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0 or Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in total employment (PAYEMS) below 145000.0 thousand persons signals labor market weakening that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS < 145000.0) fails to produce negative returns in >60% of instances or Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as predictor of 60-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
